title: Create initial project plan
notes: Fern leads creation; hands day-to-day execution to Christina ~1-2 months out.

title: Event internal kick-off call
notes: Align full team on project plan, ownership, and timeline.

title: Fern → Christina handoff
notes: After kickoff, Fern hands the plan to Christina to run day-to-day.

title: Register on-site team for event
notes: Register all team members. Send confirmations + notify Fern. Dependent on receiving registration link from Informa/event organizer.

title: Build internal hub
notes: Internal attendee tracking (multi-tab Google Sheet). Raw copy-paste from registration site. Distinct from Notion dossier master list.

title: Set up Google Script for attendee list propagation
notes: Set up the Google Script that auto-propagates attendee data into the internal hub. Internal hub is built first. Client EXT list IDs are added later once the EXT list is received — at that point, start the weekly update cadence.

title: Internal team reporting — Monday action items
notes: Monday: send team their action items for the week.

title: Internal team reporting — Wednesday mid-week check-in
notes: Wed/Thu: reminder for anything not yet completed that week.

title: Internal team reporting — Friday look-ahead
notes: Friday: preview of what's coming the following week.

title: Internal post-event debrief
notes: Fern creates a slide deck covering wins, improvements, and key numbers. Full team, 1-hour meeting. Distributed within 48 business hours of the event.

title: Project wrap-up + template update
notes: Close out the plan, document lessons learned, update templates for next event.

title: Client kick-off email
notes: Sent after signing (Fern or Nic). Event overview + upcoming items. Asks client to add marketing materials, register, book hotels. Prompts scheduling of prep, deal strategy, and debrief calls. Includes key links. Note: Beth may fill client partner role — flag for Fern. Action items for client: register for event and book hotel. Include registration and hotel links if available.

title: Collect client to-dos
notes: Collect client to-dos before the client kickoff call — the kickoff is where those to-dos get listed and assigned.

title: Send top 20 target request + EXT attendee list
notes: Send the client EXT spreadsheet (initial Informa attendee list). Client marks their top 20 operators to invite to 858 activations. Note: Beth may fill client partner role — flag for Fern. When EXT list is received, update the Google Script with client EXT spreadsheet IDs and start weekly update cadence.

title: Create + maintain client external (EXT) spreadsheets
notes: External Google Sheets with attendee list shared with each client. Refresh weekly as Informa sends updates.

title: Remind clients to schedule all three meetings
notes: Optional. By 4 weeks out, three meetings should be scheduled: prep call (2 weeks before), deal strategy call (1 week before), debrief call (1 week after). Remind weekly if not yet confirmed. Timing depends on overall client communication volume.

title: Send dossier live email
notes: Includes the Rebrandly dossier link + instructions to complete the prioritization exercise (tier 1/2, current customers, detractors).

title: Connect ESM with client (intro)
notes: Intro each client to their ESM via email/text + contact info. ESM ensures client meets and tracks their targets onsite. Note: Beth may fill client partner role — flag for Fern.

title: Client prep kickoff call
notes: Walks through the prep deck: logistics, expectations, activation format, Q&A. Note: Beth may fill client partner role — flag for Fern.

title: Client deal strategy call
notes: JG on client strategy, goals, and how to approach their tier 1/tier 2 targets. If assigned seating, reviews their table + workshop group for target coverage.

title: Post-event client thank you message via text or LinkedIn
notes: Quick personal text or LinkedIn thank-you to the client for attending.

title: Client debrief call
notes: Continues until all client meetings are completed.

title: ESM tracks top target intros with clients
notes: ESMs track introductions between clients and their top targets on event day. Ensures each client connects with their key targets.

title: ESM introductions, tracking on-site
notes: ESMs use the trackers to ensure each client meets their tier 1/2 targets onsite. All ESMs give simultaneous 5-minute personal warnings for session transitions.

title: Add client top 20 targets to internal hub
notes: Add one tab per client to the internal hub with their top 20 target list based on the top 20 target exercise.

title: Invite campaign wave management
notes: Invite campaign must be planned and set up 6 weeks before the event. Runs weekly through the event — sometimes last-minute invites go out the week of the event.

title: Send invites to nominated top targets
notes: 858-specific invite campaign for top 20 nominated targets. Not part of Informa or ICR invite process. Send as needed — ongoing maintenance, not strict weekly cadence.

title: Build Notion master attendee list
notes: Enriched master list. Per attendee: full name, job title, brand, LinkedIn, headshot, brand facts (2-3 sentences on education/past roles), buyer intent (own column from registration), registration date + email. Distinct from internal hub.

title: Build client dossier attendee list
notes: Per-client attendee list, separate from master. Copy operator info from master minus buyer intent, add buyer-intent column showing ONLY intents matching that client's solution. Never expose other clients' info or non-matching intents. Flag newly added attendees since last refresh.

title: Create copy for client dossier
notes: Draft all copy for the client dossier page: intro, agenda, team bios, contextual copy. Created before building the dossier page.

title: Build client dossier page in Notion
notes: Build full dossier page including: intro, agenda, copy, team bios, maps, priority targets, full attendee list. One Notion page per client.

title: QA client dossier
notes: CRITICAL QA before link goes live. Checklist: all links live and working, each client has only their own attendee list (no cross-client data), no spelling errors, all Notion pages published with correct sharing, shareable link confirmed working, client-specific data (buyer intents, GRIP schedule) verified accurate.

title: Publish client dossier + attendee list; set share permissions
notes: Publish both the client dossier page and attendee list in Notion. Set share permissions.

title: Create Rebrandly link with clean slug per client dossier
notes: Copy the Notion share link into Rebrandly. Create a clean, readable slug for each client dossier.

title: Run prioritization exercise with clients
notes: Clients complete after receiving dossier live email. Results inform seating chart, room assignments, and ESM trackers.

title: Update dossier attendee list
notes: Starts when dossier is live. Updated daily or multiple times per week as registrations and cancellations occur.

title: Add seating, table assignments, room assignments, and GRIP schedule to dossier
notes: Once finalized, add seating and room assignments to the client dossier.

title: Final review of dossier attendee list + send updated dossier link
notes: Verify the attendee list is as current as possible before doors open. Send updated dossier link to clients if changes were made.

title: Book hotels for on-site team
notes: Book accommodations for Fern, Christina, and any other on-site team. Per Informa partnership terms where applicable. Info-gathering may happen earlier; actual booking typically ~1 month out. Dependent on receiving hotel link from Informa/event organizer.

title: Book team flights
notes: Each team member books their own flight. Christina sends reminders and collects flight information from all on-site team members.

title: Book team dinner reservations
notes: Book team dinner for the night before (or night of) the event. Confirm headcount, restaurant, and reservation details.

title: Arrange ground transportation + car rental
notes: Confirm car rental, ride share logistics, or airport transportation for on-site team. Especially critical for multi-venue days or late-night events.

title: Coordinate on-site shipping + last-minute supply run
notes: Confirm any shipped items are on track to venue. Identify any last-minute supplies needed (e.g., espresso beans, printed materials, office supplies). Assign who picks them up on-site.

title: Send team dress code + what to bring brief
notes: Send to all on-site team: dress code (uniform look), what to bring (badge, materials, chargers, day-of supplies), schedule, and final reminders. Ensures everyone looks cohesive and is prepared.

title: Create internal team dossier
notes: Internal-only document for the on-site team. Includes dress code, what to bring, day-of logistics, schedule, and key contacts.

title: Set up day-of team communication channel
notes: Set up and brief the team on the day-of communication channel. Ensure all on-site staff are connected.

title: Remind on-site team to submit expenses to Fernando via Expensify
notes: Remind all on-site team members to submit their event expenses through Expensify to Fernando.

title: Pull prioritization data into prioritization spreadsheet
notes: Compile each client's tier 1/2, current customers, detractors from their dossier into one spreadsheet for JG.

title: Build table/room assignments
notes: JG uses Claude. Rule: each client table = 1-2 tier 1/2 targets + 1 current customer + 0 detractors. Top targets sit left/right of client; current customer across.

title: QA table/room assignments
notes: QA review of all table and room assignments before finalizing.

title: Review draft assignments with clients
notes: JG may walk clients through draft assignments on the deal strategy call and adjust on feedback.

title: Build ESM trackers
notes: Per client: tier 1/2 targets, whether they share a table/room, gaps, and GRIP schedule overlap. Sent to Nic for onsite ESM use.

title: Input check-in data into seating automation tool (onsite)
notes: Tool ingests prioritization data + check-in list and regenerates the seating plan if threshold hit (~10+ no-shows). JG approves any day-of reassignments.

title: Assign seating assignments during event rehearsal
notes: During the venue walkthrough/event rehearsal, physically walk the space to confirm table layout and finalize seating placement.

title: Draft program guide content
notes: Fern runs first draft through Claude. Sends to JG + Marty for review and visual direction.

title: JG + Marty review program guide content
notes: JG and Marty review and approve content draft. Send approval to Christina to begin Figma build.

title: Build program guide in Figma
notes: Christina builds from template. Includes team, attendees + headshots, maps, guest-speaker spotlights, what to expect.

title: Review cycle — JG + Marty review program guide
notes: JG and Marty review the built guide. Christina makes edits.

title: QA program guide before PDF export
notes: QA checklist: all headshots correct, all names spelled correctly, all links working, URL slug correct, no incorrect client cross-references, event dates and venue correct.

title: Export program guide PDF + convert to shareable link
notes: Christina exports PDF after QA sign-off. JG converts to shareable link (Bitly or similar). Link goes into the KBYG email.

title: QA know before you go email copy
notes: CRITICAL QA: correct program guide link per client (no cross-client link mixing), all headshots render, email renders across Gmail/Outlook/Apple Mail.

title: Send know before you go email
notes: Carries the program guide PDF shareable link. Sent to all operators + clients.

title: Confirm floor plan + capacity from venue/Informa
notes: Confirm floor capacity, table count, room setup with venue or Informa. Needed even when seating isn't assigned. Send floor plan and capacity numbers to JG — needed for seating planning and to size the invite campaign.

title: Menu preapproval in writing
notes: Menu reviewed and approved in writing BEFORE venue contract is signed. Espresso required at every daytime 858 event — non-negotiable. Evening social menu also requires approval. Optional.

title: Food + beverage + espresso cart coordination
notes: Confirm F&B menu, catering vendor, espresso cart vendor and logistics. Source espresso beans from a client if possible. For 858 House: 9am-4pm snacks, 4pm-7pm cocktails. Lock contracts and confirm delivery times.

title: Furniture rental order
notes: Only if bringing furniture from outside the venue. Lock early — often has the earliest vendor deadline.

title: Collect tech stand requirements + send to client
notes: Collect all technical requirements for the tech stand and send to the client.

title: JG sends design requests to Fernando + Christina
notes: JG sends design briefs and content for signage, badges, and collateral.

title: Design signage + badges
notes: Christina designs badges, note cards, directional signs, table number signs, and collateral. Fern approves and orders printing. Table number signs must be included in photographer's table shot brief.

title: Order + ship marketing collateral
notes: Order all printed/physical marketing collateral and ship to venue.

title: On-site team picks up marketing collateral
notes: Confirm on-site pickup of all marketing collateral at the venue.

title: Swag order
notes: Source, brand, and deliver attendee swag to the venue.

title: Marketing materials for Informa submission
notes: Collect client logos + bios and 858 logo/bio. Submit to event or Informa per required deadlines.

title: Confirm AV + tech setup
notes: 858 owns: laptop, HDMI, cables. Purchase and test before event. Never rely on JG's personal equipment or venue Bluetooth. Confirm microphone/PA for any session with 10+ attendees.

title: Confirm Wi-Fi + internet access
notes: Confirm venue WiFi credentials and bandwidth for the day. Especially critical for 858 House lounge and any session using live data or real-time tools.

title: Hire extra staff
notes: Check-in help, room flips, extra F&B staff as needed. For large-scale events. ESM and brand connector roles evaluated for consolidation.

title: Designate music lead + build playlists
notes: Assign music lead (owns the board all day — not a playlist on shuffle). Build moment-by-moment playlists: arrival/registration (warm, low BPM), session opens (fade to zero — 8-second rule), breaks (energy lift), networking, close. Download offline — no streaming dependency. 858-owned equipment (Sonos portable or JBL EON).

title: Vendor parking + load-in/load-out coordination
notes: Confirm load-in times, dock access, vendor parking, and load-out schedule for all vendors (espresso, furniture, decor, staffing).

title: Shipping logistics
notes: Coordinate shipping of swag, signage, badges, and any event materials to the venue. Confirm tracking and delivery confirmation.

title: Build run-of-show + designate transition leads
notes: Detailed minute-by-minute schedule. Include: where to be and when, designated transition lead per room (JG is NEVER the transition lead), ESM 5-minute warning protocol, and music cues. Also feeds the photography dossier.

title: Venue walkthrough + event rehearsal
notes: Physical walkthrough of ALL venues (day + evening). Fern walks everyone through the space. JG practices speeches. AV setups tested. Music tested.

title: Vendor invoice tracking + payment
notes: Track all outstanding vendor invoices post-event. Flag any that are overdue. Notify Fern to process payments per contract terms.

title: Create standard copy for handwritten note
notes: Standard copy for attendees added too late for personalization or not prioritized by JG. Draft before starting spreadsheet.

title: Create handwritten notes spreadsheet
notes: List all attendees including clients. Categorize by note type. Ongoing — update as registrations and cancellations come in.

title: Send handwritten notes spreadsheet to JG
notes: JG reviews and adds personalized note copy for key attendees.

title: Update handwritten notes spreadsheet
notes: Ongoing updates as new registrants are added and cancellations occur.

title: Produce handwritten notes (run machine)
notes: Upload finalized spreadsheet to machine software. Run machine to produce notes and envelopes. Repeat as spreadsheet updates.

title: QA handwritten notes + envelopes
notes: Verify all notes are for confirmed attendees. Remove any canceled. Check all envelopes are correctly addressed.

title: Package + ship handwritten notes to venue/hotel
notes: Ship via UPS to venue, hotel, or Fernando. Include extra blank cards, envelopes, and the machine pen for on-site additions.

title: On-site team picks up handwritten notes package
notes: Confirm receipt of the handwritten notes package on-site.

title: Write handwritten notes for on-site new additions
notes: Write notes for attendees who registered after the shipment was sent.

title: Confirm handwritten notes against final attendee list
notes: Night before: final match of notes against most current attendee list. Remove notes for cancellations.

title: Place handwritten notes on seats/tables
notes: Place each note on the corresponding seat before doors open.

title: Set up Luma event page
notes: Luma event page must be live before invite campaign begins.

title: Monitor registration for daily Luma approval
notes: Review and approve new registrations in Luma daily. Starts when dossier goes live.

title: Send Luma reminder — day before + morning of event
notes: Send Luma reminder email the day before. Send again morning of event with location, start time, and check-in instructions.

title: Brief chief of staff
notes: Brief Fern or designee on the day's plan.

title: Day-of check-in setup + live no-show tracking
notes: Set up check-in (iPad/list, registration desk, escort). Capture walk-ins. Track no-shows in real time. Share final check-in list with Nic, JG, and Robin post-event.

title: Collect + send group insights post-activation
notes: Collect Granola recording, note card takeaways, and key themes from each workshop room. Send summary to the team.

title: Recruit + confirm workshop moderators
notes: Identify and confirm one moderator per room. 4 rooms = 4 moderators. Confirm availability on the content planning call.

title: Build workshop discussion prompts + content framework
notes: Pre-set discussion questions, ranking exercises, group discussion format per table/room. Each sub-group nominates one person to share back. Questions approved by 858 in advance. Moderators need clear questions + expected outcomes.

title: Write moderator guide
notes: Create one-page moderator guide per room: session objectives, discussion questions, timing, ground rules, what to do if conversation stalls.

title: Schedule + prepare moderator prep meeting
notes: Schedule and prepare all materials for the moderator prep meeting.

title: Hold moderator prep meeting + distribute notes
notes: Brief all moderators before event day. Distribute meeting notes and cheat sheet for each room.

title: Prep workshop room supplies + Granola setup
notes: Note cards, pens, name tents per seat, printed discussion prompts at each table. Set up Granola recording device in each room. Confirm furniture and room layout match the floor plan.

title: Write + approve sponsor intro scripts
notes: JG delivers ALL sponsor introductions (30-second scripted reads). Format: operator problem first, one differentiating line, named customer in the room, named sponsor rep. Sponsors NEVER self-present. Scripts locked by 858 in advance.

title: Build + confirm housekeeping slides with client logos
notes: Slides shown during remarks with client logos rotating on screen. Confirm screen/monitor availability with venue contact. Confidence monitor also confirmed.

title: Write + finalize JG opening remarks
notes: JG drafts opening remarks. Include: how clients are introduced (operator problem first — never self-presented), event framing, and client intro remarks. Multiple review rounds before final.

title: 858 House venue + lounge setup coordination
notes: Luxury lounge feel. Full bar, espresso, high-end F&B. Confirm room setup, furniture, and vendor logistics. Confirm lounge hours. Determine if tent needed.

title: 858 House check-in + table reservations setup
notes: Build check-in system. Clients can reserve tables in advance for prospect meetings. Confirm escort and front-desk check-in staffing.

title: Confirm GRIP designate per partner
notes: Each partner assigns one person (designator) to log into GRIP and make selections for the company. Each client gets 10 meetings per company even with 2 attendees.

title: Client completes GRIP operator preference selections (top 40)
notes: Designator logs into GRIP and selects up to 40 operators to meet. Cross-reference dossier tier 1/2 to help prioritize. Operators also make selections; GRIP matches on mutual interest.

title: Review preliminary GRIP meeting schedule + flag issues
notes: Informa publishes a draft schedule. Review each client's 10 meetings and flag conflicts or mismatches directly with Informa.

title: GRIP on-site support + ESM coverage
notes: 10 x 10-min back-to-back 1:1s per client. ESMs keep each client on time and equipped, flag no-shows, manage transitions between meetings.

title: Presentation: submit materials to Informa
notes: Submit presentation deck, speaker bio/headshot, and any supporting materials required by Informa. Confirm submission deadlines with Informa contact. For CREATE: submit Innovation Forum materials per Informa deadline.

title: Presentation: AV rehearsal + final speaker prep
notes: JG rehearses the presentation. Test AV, clicker, slide transitions. Confirm confidence monitor. Happens during the venue walkthrough day before.

title: Research + identify guest speaker candidates
notes: JG, Fernando, and Marty identify who they want as outside speaker or guest draw. Fit criteria: relevant to operator audience, credible brand, willing to participate. Build shortlist.

title: Outreach to guest speaker candidates
notes: Fern leads outreach to speaker candidates. Confirm interest, availability, format, and any fee or reimbursement expectations. Escalate to JG for any high-profile targets.

title: Confirm + sign guest speaker agreement
notes: Sign agreement covering format, session length, travel/hotel reimbursement policy, invoice process, and any usage rights. Confirm speaker is aware this is not a self-promotional slot.

title: Guest speaker briefing meeting
notes: Meet with confirmed speaker to walk through: 858 event format, what their session looks like, how long, who the audience is, what we expect (not a sales pitch), what to expect from attendees, Q&A format.

title: Collect speaker bio + headshot
notes: Collect speaker's bio, headshot, and preferred contact info. Used in: program guide (speaker spotlight section), post-event recap (guest speaker section), and post-event comms.

title: Send speaker run-of-show, collateral + logistics brief
notes: Send speaker the run-of-show, all event collateral, and full logistics brief: on-site contact, arrival logistics, hotel booking details.

title: Coordinate speaker travel + hotel invoice reimbursement
notes: Speaker books their own travel and hotel. After the event, collect invoice(s) and process reimbursement per agreement terms. Confirm with Fern on payment timeline.

title: Research + vet photographers
notes: Get 2-3 quotes per city. Review portfolios. Research walk-in headshot options for unregistered attendees. Consider past photographers by city.

title: Negotiate + sign photography contract
notes: Contract MUST include: same-day selects (20-40 edited photos by EOD or early next morning), 24-48 hr full gallery delivery SLA with rush fee pre-approved. Pre-event call if first time with 858.

title: Pay photography deposit
notes: Pay deposit per contract terms immediately upon signing.

title: Build photographer dossier + Robin dossier
notes: Build photographer's and Robin's dossiers. Includes run-of-show, event schedule, key shot list, contacts.

title: Send photographer dossier + Robin dossier (with updated attendee list)
notes: Send finalized dossiers to photographer and Robin with the most current attendee list.

title: Receive same-day photo selects
notes: Receive 20-40 edited photos from photographer by EOD or early next morning. Must include all table/room linking shots.

title: Organize same-day photo selects by table/room + send to TBD
notes: Organize same-day selects by table or room. Send organized folder to TBD for table/room linking emails.

title: Receive full photo gallery from photographer
notes: Per contract SLA (3-7 business days). 200-1,000 photos: speakers, food/decor, venue, candids, team, all linking shots.

title: Send gallery + final check-in list to Robin
notes: Include full gallery, final check-in list with no-shows flagged, and updated attendee list (including any walk-in headshots researched) for Robin's reference when organizing.

title: Robin organizes photos by operator + delivers folders
notes: Robin creates one folder per operator (50-200+ people). Takes approximately 2-4 business days. Christina confirms delivery and quality.

title: Approve Robin invoice + notify Fern for payment
notes: Christina approves Robin's invoice, then notifies Fern to process payment via Gusto. Robin paid $450/event for photo organization.

title: Pay photographer final invoice
notes: Process photographer's final payment per contract terms after gallery delivery confirmed.

title: Create email copy doc for linking emails
notes: Open doc pre-event; stage with placeholder table structure, LinkedIn link slots, and photo placeholders so JG can preview the format before event day.

title: JG edits + approves email copy for linking emails
notes: JG reviews and approves linking email copy before staging.

title: Stage mock linking email for JG approval
notes: TBD stages a mock email. JG reviews and approves.

title: Receive same-day photo selects + organize by table/room
notes: Same-day selects must include all table and room linking shots. Christina labels and drops linking shots into Google Drive folders organized by table/room.

title: Receive check-in list
notes: Receive from on-site team.

title: Send TBD the Google folders (organized photos, check-in list, Notion dossier for LinkedIns)
notes: Send TBD: organized operator photo folders, final check-in list, Notion dossier links for LinkedIn lookups.

title: Finalize email distribution list organized by table/room
notes: TBD organizes final confirmed seating — removes no-shows, adds walk-ins, confirms accurate table/room mapping.

title: Populate linking emails: photos + LinkedIn + table discussion note
notes: Insert final table/room photos + LinkedIn profile links per attendee + a brief note on what the table discussed. One email per table (luncheon) or room (workshop).

title: QA all linking emails before send
notes: CRITICAL QA: each email contains ONLY that table's photos and links (no cross-client mixing), all LinkedIn URLs valid, all photos render, no-shows removed, copy sounds personal not AI-generated. Test email across Gmail/Outlook/Apple Mail.

title: Final review + send linking emails
notes: JG final review and approval. Send individually — one email per table (luncheon) or room (workshop).

title: Collect brand + client feedback, Granola notes + chief of staff notes
notes: Collect all post-event input: brand feedback, client feedback, Granola meeting notes, and chief of staff notes. Feeds into recap copy draft.

title: Draft post-event recap copy
notes: Full recap structure: intro, event overview, carousel of highlights, reporting/infographic (Nic), guest speaker spotlight, brand exec quotes (operator quotes — no names), feedback and learnings, gratitude (client logos), client attendee headshots + LinkedIn links, event photo album link. Uses program guide, emails, event notes.

title: Draft recap video copy
notes: Draft copy for recap video.

title: Nic adds reporting layer + infographic
notes: Buyer-intent reporting, operator/client feedback summary, ESM debrief notes, and infographic visual.

title: Nic reviews post-event recap copy (first draft), edits + approves
notes: Nic reviews Christina's first draft, makes edits, approves, and sends to JG + Marty.

title: JG + Marty final content review + approve
notes: Final content edit + approval before Webflow build.

title: Build visual recap in Webflow
notes: Once full gallery is available. Christina builds from Webflow template: photos, infographic, CMS page content, and photo album link all in one combined build.

title: Review cycle — JG + Marty review visual recap
notes: JG and Marty review the built visual recap. Christina makes edits.

title: QA recap before going live
notes: QA checklist: all photo links work, all headshots correct, all names correct, event album link works, Webflow page renders correctly on mobile and desktop, no broken images.

title: Make recap live + share link with TBD
notes: Make the Webflow link live. Share with TBD for inclusion in 1:1 follow-up emails. Share with the broader team.

title: Christina sends TBD organized operator photo folders
notes: Send TBD the Google Drive folders with Robin's organized operator photos for 1:1 emails.

title: Create 1:1 follow-up copy doc + template
notes: Christina creates structure + optional Claude template. TBD and JG own the copy.

title: Edit 1:1 email copy doc + template; review + approve
notes: Personalized per operator — references the event + a personal note from JG. TBD drafts; JG reviews.

title: Stage 1:1 emails
notes: Stage all 1:1 operator emails for final QA and send.

title: Attach organized photo from Robin's folders
notes: TBD pulls each operator's individual photo from Robin's organized folders for individual email attachment.

title: QA 1:1 emails before send
notes: Verify: correct photo per operator, recap link is correct and live, no duplicate sends, copy is personalized not generic, all names spelled correctly.

title: Send 1:1 emails individually
notes: TBD confirms photos + copy per operator. Sends individually — each with their personal photo + the live recap link. JG reviews selectively.

title: Invited but non-attendee follow-up email
notes: OPTIONAL / conditional. Send a personalized follow-up to people who were invited but did not attend — including no-shows, cancellations, and anyone who never registered. Copy acknowledges they missed it, shares a link to the recap, and keeps the relationship warm. Decide per event whether to run this.
